rationale: Build on the current recurrent-tail baseline by aligning the recurrence curriculum to the actual 600s train budget instead of nominal iteration count, then locking into full recurrence once quant-aware training starts. This is a compact structural change aimed directly at the final int8 roundtrip objective: spend more of the real wallclock run training closer to the evaluation graph without adding parameters or export complexity.
title: Wallclock-Aligned Reverse-Tail Curriculum
